content.rendered:
Treatable Conditions

Stem cells can be utilized to treat a variety of medical conditions and 23 Century Beike’s partner hospitals have treated various neurological disorders, auto-immune and inflammatory diseases, muscular dystrophies and myopathies, optic nerve and retina related visual impairments, as well as certain intestinal conditions.

On the right is a list of the most commonly treated disorders. Feel free to browse each medical condition’s treatment page to learn more about the benefits of stem cell therapy.
